title: Anthropic Office Suite Upgrade: Meeting Assistant and Smart Spreadsheets Launch Together, Making a Full-Scale Push into the Heartland of Traditional Collaboration Giants
excerpt: As AI becomes increasingly integrated into office scenarios, AI company Anthropic has recently officially launched a series of new features for enterprise users
content_html:
As AI becomes increasingly integrated into office scenarios, AI company Anthropic has recently officially launched a series of new features for enterprise users, further expanding its use cases in daily workflows. The core features in this release include Claude Meetings, Claude Whiteboards, Claude Sheets, and Claude Data, building a comprehensive tool matrix that covers the entire team collaboration process.

Meeting Assistant and Whiteboards Launch: Track Discussions in Real Time and Automatically Generate Workspaces

In everyday team collaboration and communication, the newly launched Claude Meetings offers a unique interaction format. It can join video meetings directly as a visible participant, track the discussion in real time, and automatically generate related meeting outputs. Initially, this feature is being tested mainly for Team and Enterprise plans, with first support for Google Meet. It will automatically leave when it detects that an external guest has joined, helping protect enterprise data security.

At the same time, Claude Whiteboards can quickly organize scattered ideas from team discussions into visual workspaces with clear owners and deadlines. It also supports one-click conversion into standard documents or presentations, effectively improving efficiency in project planning and bringing ideas to life.

Smart Sheets and Data Dashboards: Seamlessly Connect Business Systems and Support Deep Queries

For data processing and business tracking, Claude Sheets lets users create spreadsheets with multiple worksheets, complex formulas, and professional formatting directly through simple prompts. All changes made by AI are clearly marked. This feature is now broadly available in beta to paid users, along with the whiteboard tool.

In addition, Claude Dashboards, which had drawn considerable attention, has been officially renamed Claude Data and is now broadly available. The tool can seamlessly connect to a company's underlying data warehouse and CRM systems, and can respond to complex business data queries in a variety of intuitive formats.

Deep Integration with Third-Party Ecosystems: Mainstream Office Tools Embedded Directly in the Interface

To better integrate into existing enterprise software ecosystems, Anthropic has also fully upgraded its interactive connectors.

With the new upgrade, the system supports a range of mainstream third-party apps, including Adobe, Atlassian, and HubSpot, by directly embedding their complete user interfaces within Claude's conversation interface. This lets users avoid frequently switching between multiple software tools in their daily work, further improving overall collaboration efficiency.
